issues.description: Computed pixel memory address placement mismatch: the problem statement and template require the full pixel memory address to be produced in register ESI (so main can read the pixel with mov ecx, [esi] and later save/push that address). The solution's main routine computes a byte offset into EDI and then uses mov ecx, [edi] without adding the display_start base to produce an absolute address, while ESI is left containing only display_start. As a result main later pushes ESI expecting the full pixel address but ESI does not contain the correct final address; the code reads/writes the wrong memory location and will confuse or break students who follow the template requirement to place the address in ESI.
issues.suggestedFix: Produce the full absolute pixel address in ESI as specified by the problem and template. Concretely: compute byte_offset = x*4 + y*(1920*4) (i.e. x*4 and y*7680), then add display_start to byte_offset and store the sum in ESI. Use mov ecx, [esi] to read the pixel and later push ESI (or otherwise pass ESI) so main sees the full address. Ensure any registers you modify (other than the allowed eax/ebx per spec) are saved/restored according to the template's comments.
